name: Vite
summary: Vite is a next-generation frontend build tool. Its rolling support policy defines the terminal support dates for Vite 5 and 6 minor lines at releases that move those lines out of the supported ranges.

eol.quote: The supported version ranges are automatically determined by: Current Minor gets regular fixes. Previous Major (only for its latest minor) and Previous Minor receives important fixes and security patches. Second-to-last Major (only for its latest minor) and Second-to-last Minor receives security patches. All versions before these are no longer supported.

notes: Tier: researched. GA dates and trigger dates use Vite's official GitHub release objects. Every non-null eol is derived from Vite's explicit rolling support policy, not from release cadence and not from Node.js EOL inheritance. Vite 6.4 remains current in the researched policy snapshot, so its EOL is deliberately unknown.
